title: FindMyJob
description: Automated job search platform that scrapes listings from multiple websites and provides a personalized dashboard for tracking applications.
additionalInfo: This project is designed to automate the job search process by scraping job listings from various websites and providing users with a personalized dashboard to track their applications.

title: Admin Panel
description: Full-featured admin dashboard with user management, role-based access control, content management, and data visualization.
additionalInfo: This project is an admin panel that allows administrators to manage users, content, and settings for a web application. It includes features such as user authentication, role-based access control, and data visualization.

title: Todo App
description: Task management application with creation, editing, deletion, and categorization features built with the MERN stack.
additionalInfo: This project is a todo app that helps users manage their tasks efficiently. It includes features such as task creation, editing, deletion, and categorization.
